title: SB5140 (2025-2026 Regular): Enhancing requirements relating to the purchase, transfer, and possession of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/biennium/2025-26/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/5140.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version (SB 5140, 2025-26; read-first-time 2025-01-06); effective date in text is November 1, 2026 (Sec. 19). Large file; quoted the permit core only. Other parts not quoted: Sec. 2(2)-(5),(8)-(12),(14)-(16) application, renewal and reports; Sec. 3 training standards (RCW 9.41.1132); Sec. 4 state patrol certification of trainers; Sec. 7, 9-11, 13-17 conforming changes, delayed-transfer rules, superior court appeal (Sec. 12), recordkeeping of all transfers (Sec. 13). Sec. 1 also strikes the old purchaser training-proof requirement and adds delay rules for outstanding warrants and open charges.
